prompt_fragment: This asset is a background or texture. Prioritize atmosphere and surface coherence over a single isolated subject.
raw_description:
A wide horizontal band of pale aurora cyan-green with faint purple
undertones, soft-edged and ribbon-like, painterly with suggested wisps
and fade-outs. Intended as an overlay accent.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor wash on aged parchment, a wide horizontal aurora ribbon of pale cyan-green with faint violet undertones drifting across open polar sky, ribboning light punctuated by slate shadow and warm vellum cream at the edges.

subjects.description: Wide soft-edged horizontal ribbon, painterly wisps fading at both margins, cool prismatic shimmer at the light core, loose wet-on-wet watercolor layering, slow meditative drift.
subjects.position: center horizontal band spanning full width

subjects.description: Aged parchment grain beneath, faint foxing at corners, deep slate ink at upper and lower margins dissolving into warm vellum mid-field.
